native_task.objective: maximize unchanged terminal task quality with the entire fixed initial resource allocated by true terminal
native_task.cost: actual debit/initial resource, sum per complete episode=1
native_task.public_neural_inputs: current local/global only; no simulator/quality oracle or future disturbance
native_task.action_interface: shared public dynamically completable [lower,upper] total plus object controls

methods.name: CAL
methods.title: Off-Policy Primal-Dual Safe Reinforcement Learning
methods.implementation: pinned official learning core; explicit device and finite-horizon interface
methods.mechanism: cost ensemble upper confidence estimate and local policy convexification

methods.name: CCPO（固定预算适配）
methods.title: Constraint-Conditioned Policy Optimization for Versatile Safe Reinforcement Learning
methods.implementation: paper-derived VVE and CVI; all numerical choices registered; not an author-code reproduction
methods.mechanism: factorized threshold-conditioned critics, convex dual E-step, KL-constrained actor M-step
methods.extra_data: same full initial resource and full spend for every online episode
methods.task_adaptation: single-budget specialization retains VVE/CVI; four episodes per epoch and batch512; no multi-threshold claim

methods.name: C-PPO（全额任务适配）
methods.title: CCPO: Conservatively Constrained Policy Optimization Using State Augmentation
methods.implementation: paper-derived PyTorch C-PPO; no unlicensed author TensorFlow code copied
methods.mechanism: remaining-budget state, linear safety promotion function and adaptive weighted-cost penalty
methods.identity_note: different paper and algorithm from NeurIPS CCPO; this is not vanilla PPO
methods.task_adaptation: SPF cost normalized by analytical full-spend bound K_H=1.5-1/(2H); resource cost and safety state retain physical unit budget

methods.name: Safe SAC (Jiang et al.)
methods.title: Reward Penalties on Augmented States for Solving Richly Constrained RL Effectively
methods.implementation: paper-derived continuous numerical adaptation; discrete public implementation audited rather than copied as continuous SAC
methods.mechanism: accumulated-cost augmentation, violating-trajectory penalty and constrained action search
methods.numerical_limit: finite candidate search plus gradient refinement; neither global argmax nor learned hard-safety guarantee

methods.name: SafeDreamer (OSRP-Lag)
methods.title: SafeDreamer: Safe Reinforcement Learning with World Model
methods.implementation: official vector world model, reward/cost heads, dual value functions and PID/CCEM planning
methods.mechanism: learned multi-step outcome/cost forecasting and online constrained action-sequence planning

scientific_limits: These are explicitly adapted comparisons for a full-allocation task, not unchanged original-paper benchmarks.
Common public hard constraints enforce full allocation; identical resource usage does not prove the separate learned safety components.
CCPO is the fixed-budget VVE/CVI specialization; multiple lower episode-budget constraints would be infeasible here.
C-PPO weighted-cost normalization uses the proved finite-horizon bound so its surrogate is not infeasible.
The previously approved SafeDreamer fast configuration remains explicitly labelled.
storage: one fixed endpoint evaluation model plus complete reward/evaluation CSV; no disk replay or optimizer backup
